tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus

pa bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal nag po chen po'i sbyin sreg mdor bsdus pa ni/ thab blo bslangs su byed na stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi la dpangs mtho gang tsam bya/ de'i dbus su thab rtsig pa'am/ brus pa'i sor bzhi tsam brus/ sor brgyad tsam brtsigs nas rtsig pa'i srab mthug sor bzhi yod par bya/ de'i phyi kha khyer so sor dbyibs gru gsum nyid kyi chog /ngos re gru gang ba yong bar bya/ drag po kho na la sor nyi shu ba yin te/ mtha' gcig tu ma nges/ phyi nang thams cad tshon nag po'am/ ro sol gyis byugs/ de'i steng du las dang mthun pa'i kha dog gzhan gyis bsgyur te/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ bris thabs su byed na thig chen brgyad gtab pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ kha khyer la khro ba'i rdo rje bri/ thab kyis nang du padma 'dab brgyad dam/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad/ lte ba la gri gug cig 'bri'o/ /zur gsum rtse mo phar bstan par bya/ thab kyi g.yon du mchod rdzas dang*/ rang gi g.yon du bsreg rdzas bshams/ gtor ma ji ltar bde ba la bsgrig zhi ba rkyang pa la mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bsham tshul te go ldog yin/ thab zhal byang du phyogs/ rang nyid kha lhor lta/ shing tsher ma can gtsor byed gzhan yang skam yang dang mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs pa'i bud shing dang*/'bul rgyu'i yam shing sha khrag rus gsum skra shad snum nag /sran ma/ bra bo/ yungs dkar/ yungs nag /ske tshe sogs 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa dang*/ dug khrag dang*/ bung bu'i sbangs dang*/ lan tsha sogs bsham/ bzlog pa gal che ba dang*/ drag las dmigs bsal can yin na/ ling ga che bar grags pa brub khung gcig gi nang du rdzas dang bcas pa'i ling ga dang ling chung gnyis ka bsham/ bzlog pa tsam dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs dngos grub kyi don yin na/ snod gcig tu phye mar liṅga byas pa dang*/ khrag byugs pa'i ling chung 'ga' shas bshams pas

chog /phud dang rakta yang bshams dgos/ cho ga dngos ni sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byad byin rlabs/ yi dam gang byed kyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa'i bar bya/ thab khung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i thab khung gru gsum pa las thams cad sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod/ bsreg rdzas rnams la rakta dang nang mchod gtor/ oṃ oṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ shriṃ swāhā/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ/ zhes thab khung du me sbar/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thab khung gi me ltar gyur pa ni sku mdog nag po bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa srin po'i lus can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ / 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ agne ye hūṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis dgang blugs phul/ oṃ agne ye gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod/ arghṃ sogs/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ṭakki dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg / 'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ / ces bstod/ yang blugs gzar gcig phul/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs dang*/ stong par sbyangs pa nas bzung dam la bzhag pa'i bar mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i bar gtor chog bzhin du bya/ yang mchod bstod bskul bar bya ste/ brub khung du liṅga che ba bcas yod pa'i rigs yin nam/ bden bdar dgug gzhugs sogs spyi dang 'dra ba'i mthar

shā sa na bzlas bzhin du thun gyis brab/ oṃ mahā kā la gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ral gri'am gri gug gis dum bu mang por btubs/ ling chung rnams kyang yid kyis dgra bgegs dngos su bskyed cing*/ dgug gzhugs yang yang bya/ oṃ mahā ka la sogs gong bzhin dang*/ shā sa na 'i sngags bzlas pas blugs gzar gyis blangs nas/ khrag gi arghaṃ lan gsum phul/ de nas mar nag gi dgang blugs lan bdun tsam phul nas/ sngags de dag nyid tsher ma can gy-i yam shing nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs 'bul/ liṅga bsgral ba yin na/ de nas ling ro rnams sngags de nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa gcig phul/ ling chung rnams ma gtub par dgra bgegs dngos su bsam la 'bul/ de'i rjes su bsreg rdzas gzhan thams cad bsregs nas gong du bstan pa'i sngags de nyid kyi 'bul te/ mthar chang blugs gzar gsum 'bul bar bya'o/ /yam shing mar nag bar skabs de dag tu gang babs babs su 'bul dgos/ dmigs pa ni/ dkyus kyi nyams len lam dam rdzas sha khrag gi rgya mtsho dang*/ mchod rdzas bzang dgur mos nas 'bul/ drag las kyi skabs yin na dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa zhag sogs kyi dbyibs mthun sbyar nas 'bul/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad skad cig gis bkug nas de nyid du dum bu brgya stong du brlags nas sha mchod rus mchod du chem chem gsol ba dang*/ mes bsregs nas thal ba yang sbur sbur 'gro ba dang*/ skad cig la myags pa sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs par bsam mo/ / mthar gtor bsngo'i bzhin du gtor ma 'bul ba dang*/ mchod bstod bskul ba yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra bar bya ste/ thal ba nas cung zad rang gi snying gar byugs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim mo/ / yang blugs gzar gcig phul bas/ me dpung me lha'i rnam par 'gyur/ bsregs rdzas lhag ma rnams gong bzhin du brtan pa'i gsang sngags dang bcas pas lan bdun 'bul/

mthar gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ agne ye swāhā/ a kā ro btags pa'i mthar/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags te lan gsum phul nas/ yang gong bzhin dgang blugs bdun 'bul/ mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol/ gyi mthar/ oṃ agne ye gatstsha/ zhes me lha gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sogs bsrung ba dang*/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ / las bzhi so so'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa byed na/ yi dam gyi sbyin sreg gi 'don pa spo bas cho ga la/ 'dir bzlog pa cung zad drag po dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa'i dbang du byas so/ /dpal gur gyi mgon po la sogs pa'i chos skyong gi rigs phal che ba'i sbyin sreg mdo tsam 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // bkra shis par gyur cig/ rab dkar 'dis mtshon skye 'phags dge chen gyis/ /dus mthar rgyal bstan dbu 'phang mtho ba dang*/ /chabs cig 'gro la phan bde yongs spel zhing*/ /bstan 'gro'i gsungs rim rlabs chen spyod gyur cig /rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i/ /rnam sprul rje btsun yon tan bzang po yis/ /spyi lo chig stong dgu brgya go lnga lor/ /rgyal bstan mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i phyir/ / kun mkhyen tā ra nā tha'i bka' 'bum gyi/ /shing par 'dzam thang gtsang ba'i chos grwa cher/ /bskrun pa'i dge ba 'od dkar dri med kyis/ /mar gyur 'gro la rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog/// maṅga laṃ// bkra shis par gyur cig/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 84 -- PAGE 85 - - PAGE 81 -
